verdict.rationale: Every gstack skill is a plain SKILL.md file in its own folder (review/, qa/, ship/, cso/ and others). Dev mode simply symlinks the repo into .claude/skills/, so skills are read straight from the checkout. Portability is backed by many documented hosts (Codex, Cursor, Kiro, OpenCode, Copilot and more), a compressed AGENTS.md digest for hosts without a full install, the community-noted git-clone-and-copy install model, and a user repackaging gstack for the gitagent registry. Missing for 10: per-host output goes through a TypeScript generator/config rather than a straight copy, some skills depend on a shipped compiled browser CLI ($B), and no doc explicitly guarantees hand-copying skills to an arbitrary harness.
